claim.en: In November 2010 President Gašparovič appointed József Nagy (Most-Híd nominee) minister of the restored Environment Ministry.
claim.sk: V novembri 2010 prezident Gašparovič vymenoval Józsefa Nagya (nominanta Most-Híd) za ministra obnoveného ministerstva životného prostredia.

findings.identity: Well-known politician József Nagy (Most-Híd, later Aliancia lists, former MEP); SME profile lists József Nagy b. 1968, environmental analyst, Aliancia, matching the candidate (58, environmental analyst, Magyar szövetség, Dunajská Streda).
findings.quote: On Tuesday, November 2, President Ivan Gašparovič appointed József Nagy as the new minister of Slovakia’s resurrected Environment Ministry, the SITA newswire wrote.
findings.title: Slovak President appoints József Nagy to lead Environment Ministry
